theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners holds the strongest detector profile: top rank (2.14), highest durability (0.82), 'trend' hurst tag, full breadth (1.0), and not crowded (z=0.75). The absolute-trend gate is validated on this market (gate_helps=true), so a trend-following lean on the leader is the one discipline-consistent call — but only as a direction, with no return forecast claimed from rank alone.
theses.dissent: Precious-metals leadership is a reflexive, sentiment-driven complex; a sharp USD or real-yield reversal would unwind the entire complex together, and the detector gives no timing edge on a reversal.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO closes below its 50-day moving average and Silver & Royalties falls faster than Gold Miners two consecutive weeks before the check-by date

theses.subject: Silver & Royalties
theses.thesis: Silver & Royalties is the confirmed challenger (rank 2, score 1.77) within the same precious-metals complex, with strong durability (0.76) and not crowded (z=0.82). Leaning alongside the leader respects the rotation structure without predicting a handoff; the broad eligibility (69%) suggests the trend is not one-narrative-fragile.
evidence: rotation margin vs leader only 0.371 (tight challenger)
theses.dissent: Silver has historically higher beta than gold on the downside; if gold corrects, silver often falls harder, making this a leveraged expression of the same crowded 'precious metals' idea even though crowding_z is below threshold.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO (silver proxy) gives back all of its 20-day relative gain versus XGD.TO (gold proxy) and closes negative over the next 30 trading days

theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: Base Metals & Copper ranks 3 and is eligible, but crowding_z is 1.11 (crowded=true). Per guardrails, crowding is a size-down caution only — never a fade or short. Given the low directional accuracy of this note, the prudent lean is 'avoid' rather than overweight: the crowding flag removes the discipline support for adding trend exposure here.
theses.dissent: Copper has a structurally tight supply story and industrial-policy tailwinds (macro theme present) that could keep the trend running despite the crowding flag — crowding has no benchmark-forward timing edge per backtest_verdict.

falsifier.text: XBM.TO makes a new 52-week high and holds above its prior 20-day high without a 5% drawdown before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
